findings.title: Do not authenticate execution principals as domain users
findings.evidence: test_review.py::test_principal: an authorized domain actor creates a contribution with installed-producer-principal; real NativeCandidates intake and ordinary subprocess check pass; check_contribution raises NotFound(user not found: installed-producer-principal).
findings.cause: _original calls workflow._valid(task[producer], row), which calls domain issue_snapshot on the execution principal.
findings.fix: Keep caller/source/current-task authorization and original private read ACL. Check frozen producer identity through the installed role binding and native read/receive authority; do not require an execution principal to be a domain user. Test distinct caller/producer/checker/integrator/reviewer/publisher and producer admission revocation. Do not simply remove producer authority validation.

findings.title: Expose authorized historical integration receipts after task replacement
findings.evidence: test_review.py::test_history: finish accepts both original tasks; public authorize_task(expected=original) creates successor; old workflow.status acceptance and NativeRelease.historical are readable, but integration.status and finish raise Task definition superseded.
findings.cause: status uses _load(accepted=True), but _original unconditionally runs _valid requiring the original to remain the current active task. accepted=True only changes allowed state.
findings.fix: Separate historical accepted status/readback from live eligibility. Authenticate current requester against current issue plus original requirement/private source ACL, preserve frozen integrity and historical publication binding. Never let a historical read authorize execute, new publication or fan-in. Keep unfinished/replaced contributions blocked. Add original/current source visibility and revocation negative tests.

reviewed_controls.originals: Actual immutable candidate receipt, origin, writable delta, closure and candidate digest are validated. Tests inject trusted produced domain row; no claim of physical process closure. No-op validates explicit terminal origin/exit/transcript shape and unchanged composition but depends on trusted terminal writer.
reviewed_controls.merge: Deterministic per-object merge, conflict refusal, exact installed resolution, explicit repin target and cycle checks reviewed. No producer head publication.
reviewed_controls.criteria: All original check IDs must be present; full original contract/source is embedded in immutable integration.json and a whole-composition check is required. This binds semantic inputs, not proof an arbitrary installed program actually assesses every criterion. Production semantic installation remains unaccepted.
reviewed_controls.review: Original producer plus integrator plus resolver author union participates in independent release review. Installed test principal strings and permissive authority ports are not real admitted production principal evidence.
reviewed_controls.release: Short guarded publication validates current source/authority and exact context policy; NativeRelease validates full check policies, review age/revocation, evidence and CAS. One native publication precedes recoverable atomic domain fan-in.
reviewed_controls.history: Historical selected release is validated independent of latest channel. R2 concerns task replacement preventing integration history exposure; original/current source permission must still gate any repair.
